title: Central Texas Fishing Guide, LLC
specs: Fishing primarily for largemouth and Guadalupe bass on Lake Travis, Lake LBJ, and Lake Austin
Use of artificial baits and lures only; all largemouth bass are catch and release
Rates are for up to two anglers; additional $50 fee for a third angler
includes: All fishing gear, equipment and tackle provided using tournament grade equipment by Shimano, Dobyns, and All-Star
blurb: Guests fish for largemouth and Guadalupe bass on guided trips using tournament grade equipment and artificial baits. Trips are offered as full day, half day, or a specialized Electronics Mastery session on Lake Travis. All largemouth bass caught are released after being caught.
extraNote: $100 deposit required to secure the date · Trips may be cancelled or rescheduled within 48 hours; deposit applies to rescheduled trip if cancelled 48 hours before trip · Late cancellations or no-shows forfeit deposit
